data.name: Jogeswar
data.gender_notes: Jogeswar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jogeswar is a Sanskrit name derived from two roots: 'Joga' meaning 'yoga' or 'union with the divine', and 'Ishwar' meaning 'Lord'. Thus, Jogeswar refers to the Lord of Yoga or the one who is in union with the divine. This name is commonly used in Hindu tradition and is believed to bring spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_meaning: Union with the divine through yoga practices.
data.etymology: Jogeswar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Yoga.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jogeswar total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
